instructor: Prof was consistently engaging during each lesson and successfully tied theories taught from the beginning of the semester. Despite being a 4th year module, he recognised the diversity of students and their varied backgrounds in political science and English literature. He therefore guided students through very complex theories and encouraged students to share their engage with them and share their opinions. The readings were moderately heavy: short and few readings but required some time to interpret and surface their deep meanings. Prof was also friendly and encouraging which made it a pleasure to attend his classes :) However, for the most part and for some students including me, the theoretical readings were very dense and complex. Therefore, at times, it was hard to articulate immediately, our own thoughts in class as we were still processing them. This might be attributed to different disciplinary backgrounds for those from the English department tended to be more able to articulate critical responses in class much faster. Perhaps, in future, Prof might want to encourage what other instructors in my experience have done which is to collect initial reactions: any feelings or thoughts, confusions, questions towards the primary or secondary (theoretical) texts, whatever they might be. Prof has done this at times, through the paintings across different periods, as an introductory activity to the theories but this can be extended directly to the syllabus texts as well. Besides this, the content materials have been meaningful, the assessments have been rigorous and the course has sparked an interest to for an independent study topic to pursue in the next semester in my home university :)

course:
Dersin en olumlu yönü iyi yapılandırılmış olması. 18.-19. yüzyıldan günümüze kadar edebiyatın nasıl anlaşıldığı, nasıl bir dönüşüm geçirdiğini hem kronolojik hem de tematik olarak takip edip yeterli bilgi edinilebiliyor. Ayrıca, sadece edebi eserlerin değil; film, resim, fotoğraf, mimari gibi başkaca sanat dallarının da anlatılan konu ile ilişkisinin ve dolayısıyla onların da geçirdiği dönüşümün dersin kapsamı içinde anlatılması dersin bütünlüklü bir şekilde anlaşılmasına olanak tanıyor.

Zannediyorum ki dersin hem lisans hem de lisansüstü öğrenciler tarafından alınıyor olması bu sonucu doğuruyor. Fakat, akademi, eğer bilgi üretme, düşünme ve yaratma faaliyetleri doğrultusunda örgütlenen bir kurumsallığa denk düşüyorsa, yazılı sınav ezberlerin tekrar edilmesi sonucunu doğuracağı için bu çabayı mümkün kılmamakta.
